For any of the specific opportunities listed below send us your resume at career@tonboimaging.com[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/6″][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_empty_space height=”20px”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column width=”1/6″][/vc_column][vc_column width=”2/3″][vc_tta_accordion][vc_tta_section title=”Sr. Content Designer/Trainer | Actively Hiring |” tab_id=”1719322234219-a30b5ba1-f804″][vc_column_text css=””]You will be part of the core documentation team that innovates, develops, and delivers a variety of content for internal and external audiences.
In this role, you will be responsible to develop and deliver technical training programs to both internal employees and external customers. You will work closely with subject matter experts (SMEs) and other stakeholders to ensure that our training programs effectively convey the technical knowledge required to support our products and solutions.

**Must Have**
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Master’s degree or certifications in training and development are a plus.
• 7-10 years of experience as an ID and Trainer or similar role, preferably in the Aerospace, defence or semiconductor or hardware tech industry.
• Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand complex technical concepts and explain them clearly and concisely.
• Experience with instructional design principles and adult learning theories.
• Proficiency in using training tools, apps and platforms, such as Powerpoint, LMS, MS Teams.
• Familiarity with building Computer Based Training (CBT) modules and IETMs
• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage and motivate learners.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities effectively.
• Sound knowledge of spoken and written English and Hindi is mandatory for this role. Any other language regional or international is an advantage
• Sound fitness to undertake outdoor trainings in demanding conditions and environment.
• Willingness to travel for on-site training sessions within and outside India.

**Responsibilities**
• Develop and deliver technical training programs for Tonbo Imaging products and systems, both in-person and through virtual platforms.
• Collaborate with SMEs and product development teams to gather technical content and ensure training materials are accurate and up-to-date.
• Design and storyboard interactive and engaging learning experiences that promote knowledge retention and application.
• Design and create training materials, including presentations, training manuals, videos, and hands-on exercises.
• Conduct training needs assessments to identify gaps and recommend improvements to existing training programs.
• Customize training programs to meet the specific needs of different audiences, including customers, partners, and internal teams.
• Ensure all learning materials are consistent with Tonbo Imaging’s branding guidelines and instructional standards.
• Coordinate logistics for training sessions, including scheduling, equipment setup, and participant registration.
• Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs through assessments and feedback mechanisms, making continuous improvements based on results.
• Stay updated on industry trends and technological advancements related to Tonbo Imaging products and solutions.
• Support the development of training content for e-learning platforms and Learning Management Systems (LMS).

Please submit your resume with a cover letter outlining your qualifications in designing learning experiences and training delivery. Include any relevant portfolio or examples of training materials you have developed/delivered.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”FPGA Engineer | Actively Hiring |” tab_id=”1786086686575-2bfe2518-bebd”][vc_column_text css=””]Key Responsibilities:
Develop UVM-based verification environments for FPGA RTL blocks and subsystems.
Write comprehensive test plans, and implement stimulus, checkers, monitors, and scoreboards.
Ensure functional correctness via SystemVerilog assertions, constrained-random testing, and coverage closure.
Analyze simulation failures and debug RTL with tools like QuestaSim/ModelSim/Vivado and waveform viewers.
Collaborate with RTL designers and systems engineers to understand requirements and corner cases.
Participate in code reviews, design documentation, and DO-254 verification artifacts.
Contribute to integration and validation efforts on target hardware platforms (Xilinx/Intel FPGAs).

Required Qualifications:
B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering.
3+ years of experience in FPGA verification.
Hands-on expertise with SystemVerilog, UVM, and functional coverage techniques.
Experience with verification tools like QuestaSim, Vivado Simulator, or VCS.
Familiarity with scripting languages (TCL, Python, Perl) for simulation automation.
Understanding of communication protocols like SPI, UART,I2C standards.Understanding of AXI and AVALON protocols.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”International Senior Business Development Manager | Actively Hiring |” tab_id=”1754291200987-bf2d208d-5e63″][vc_column_text css=””]

  • Job Title: International Senior Business Development Manager
    Company: Tonbo Systems
    Location: Global (Remote/International Travel Required)About Tonbo SystemsTonbo Systems is a global leader in cutting-edge optronics, thermal imaging, and tactical solutions. We develop and deliver mission-critical technologies to defense, security, and law enforcement agencies worldwide, enhancing operational capabilities in the most demanding environments. Our solutions redefine situational awareness, surveillance, and reconnaissance through innovation and precision engineering.Location: Remote (Candidate may operate from Europe, Middle East, or Asia Pacific)Role OverviewWe are seeking a dynamic and highly experienced Senior International Business Development Manager to spearhead global sales and strategic expansion initiatives for Tonbo Systems. The ideal candidate will have an extensive background in defense, security, and tactical solutions, with hands-on experience in operational environments. This role requires a deep understanding of modern defense and security challenges, a strong global network, and the ability to drive business growth through key partnerships and strategic engagements.Key Responsibilities

    • Global Business Development: Identify, pursue, and capture new business opportunities in defense, homeland security, and tactical markets across international regions.
    • Strategic Sales Execution: Lead the sales cycle from opportunity identification to contract closure, ensuring alignment with Tonbo’s strategic growth objectives.
    • Client & Partner Engagement: Establish and nurture strong relationships with international military, law enforcement agencies, government bodies, system integrators, and industry partners.
    • Operational Understanding: Leverage firsthand knowledge of defense and tactical operations to align Tonbo’s product offerings with real-world mission requirements.
    • Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis: Stay abreast of global market dynamics, competitor activities, and advancements in defense technologies to refine business strategies.
    • Proposal Development & Contract Negotiation: Lead the creation of comprehensive technical and commercial proposals, ensuring competitive positioning and successful contract negotiations.
    • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, product development, and marketing teams to ensure customer requirements are met with tailored solutions.
    • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure adherence to international export regulations, compliance standards, and ethical business practices.

     Experience & Qualifications

    • Military/Defense Industry Experience: Minimum of 5+ years in international business development, sales, or operations within defense, security, or tactical domains. Prior military, special operations, or law enforcement background is highly preferred.
    • Proven Sales Track Record: Demonstrated success in securing and managing multi-million-dollar contracts with global defense and security organizations.
    • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of optronics, thermal imaging, night vision, and advanced tactical technologies, with a focus on their application in real-world operations.
    • Global Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with procurement processes, defense acquisition cycles, and operational requirements across key markets such as Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific.
    • Exceptional Communication & Leadership: Ability to engage high-level stakeholders, present complex solutions clearly, and lead negotiations effectively.
    • Strategic & Adaptive Thinker: Capable of navigating diverse cultural, regulatory, and geopolitical landscapes to drive business success.

    Why Join Tonbo Systems?

    • Impact-Driven Role: Directly influence the success and adoption of advanced defense and security technologies.
    • Innovation: Work with products designed to enhance tactical effectiveness and mission success.
    • Global Exposure: Engage with defense and security organizations, participating in international missions and programs.
    • Dynamic & Fast-Paced Environment: Be part of an agile team at the forefront of defense innovation.

    How to Apply

    If you have a strong background in defense, security, or tactical operations and possess the expertise to drive global business expansion, we want to hear from you!

    Please send your CV and cover letter to akumar@tonboimaging.com.

    Tonbo Systems is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.

– Experience working for a fast-paced startup[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Communications Executive | Actively Hiring |” tab_id=”1733220573776-e59ad3db-de8f”][vc_column_text]As a Communications Executive, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the development and implementation of our internal and external communication strategies. Documentation: Maintain internal documentation through company databases, logs, or other records, and provide detailed reports regarding the IT department’s operations.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Sharepoint Admin| Actively Hiring |” tab_id=”1719322110685-c28063f8-6190″][vc_column_text]Job Type – Contract-to-hire (1 year)

You will be the primary owner of our SharePoint environments including our corporate intranet and Power automations. You will be managing site collections, sites, and document libraries, as well as developing shared storage strategies.
You will develop flows, custom dashboards, identify automation opportunities, and custom web parts to facilitate efficient use of the Sharepoint implementation.
To ensure success as a SharePoint developer, you should exhibit solid knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Sharepoint online features, functionalities such as workflows, forms, power automate, power apps etc. to create a positive experience for end-users. An outstanding SharePoint administrator will be someone whose expertise results in smooth integration and efficient online collaboration.

Responsibilities:
• Integrate applications, create, and maintain automations and flows, custom web parts
• Manage, automate, and audit Access permissions and policies
• Troubleshooting and resolving SharePoint issues or malfunctions
• Providing SharePoint support and end-user training
• Assisting with data retrieval and backup procedures to prevent data loss
• Ensuring sufficient storage space by performing and automating data management tasks
• Reviewing usage and activity reports ensuring an optimized user-experience
• Understand business requirements and translate them to effective Sharepoint solutions
• Implementing, and maintaining security controls, including Data Loss Prevention policies, consistent with Tonbo’ s security objectives
• Keeping up to date with SharePoint developments and performing version updates and upgrades

Required Skills/Abilities:
• Extensive knowledge of Windows operating systems, Power Apps, as well as
familiarity with SQL Server, Power apps, PowerShell, JavaScript, jQuery etc.
• In-depth knowledge of MS365 and SharePoint Online features and functionality, such as access controls, workflows, forms, approvals, etc
• Understanding of Microsoft best practices
• General expertise with web technologies used for application integrations such as the proper and secure use of Application Programming interfaces (APIs)
• A balanced security mindset toward minimizing risks to data and systems while performing other job functions
• Superb collaboration, interpersonal, and communication skills
• Advanced analytical and problem-solving abilities
• Excellent organizational and time-management skills

Education and Experience:
• Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or similar.
• Relevant Sharepoint developer and administrator certifications
• 4-5 years of experience as a SharePoint developer/administrator.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Asst. End-to-End Ownership from concept to realization of product functions.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Embedded Engineer `{` JOB ID : 155003`}` | Actively Hiring |” tab_id=”1607058455216-2923ada9-f16c”][vc_column_text]

  • BS/BTech/MS/MTech in Electronics / Computer Science or related field with a minimum 3+ years of experience in developing embedded systems.

  • Experience in configuring 8/16/32 bit microcontrollers. Interfacing peripherals over communication protocols such as SPI, UART, CAN, I2C , Ethernet etc
  • Experience in debugging embedded hardware.
  • Good understanding about software life cycle
  • Experience in developing firmware for microcontrollers, Board bring up etc
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment where multi-tasking will be required
  • Should have good interpersonal skills.
  • Good communication skills are a must.

Good to have 

  • Knowledge on camera , video , Image processing , etc
  • Knowledge of interfacing GPS, camera , IMU , sensor etc.
  • Experience on Python is an  advantage.
  • Working experience on TI microcontroller / TI tools.

 

Roles:

  • Person would be responsible for developing and enhancing key backbone technologies. He should be able to conceptualize, design, prototype and deploy full systems to clients. Should be able to come up with software architectures, develop/share best practices and develop robust systems. The position involves a significant level of autonomy and responsibility in which a self-motivated applicant must work independently and closely with other subject matter specialists to develop holistic product design solutions. End-to-End Ownership from concept to realization of product functions.
  • Developing firmware for TI based microcontrollers.
  • Developing device drivers for linux based platforms.
  • Developing test automation using python
  • Developing softwares for linux based platforms.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Electronics hardware design engineer `{` JOB ID : 155004`}` | Actively Hiring |” tab_id=”1607058345837-9eb08630-60b5″][vc_column_text]

Job description

  • Good knowledge in Electronics hardware.
  • Knowledge of Cadence sch capture and  PCB design tools.
  • Good knowledge of Circuit Theory and Electronic Devices
  • Should have good hardware design and development knowledge (requirements definition, design, reviews, testing etc).
  • Design knowledge in Analog and Digital Circuits
  • Digital design experience including micro-controllers, SPI, I2C, RS232,RS422, Ethernet etc.
  • Analog design experience including active passive filters, amplifiers is helpful.
  • Capable of  conceptual design, parts selection, design simulation, detailed design, schematic capture and PCB design rules creation.
  • Should be able to troubleshoot embedded boards/systems.
  • Capable of writing supporting documentation to coordinate and establish layout practices and test procedures for the current design.
  • Hands-on experience on using Lap tools like multimeter , Digital oscilloscope , spectrum analyzer , power supply etc
  • Design knowledge in analog and digital video interfacing will be a plus point.
  • Design knowledge on EMI/ EMC will be a plus point.
  • Good to have knowledge in c programming
  • Good written & verbal communication skills.

 

Role and responsibility

  •   Responsible for the design and development of new products as well as the support and modification of existing products.
  • Coordinate with layout teams to monitor correct guidelines are being followed.
  • Manage prototype builds with contract manufacturers.
  • Review Execute test protocols and document results.
  • Support the boards and systems during environmental testing and entry into production.
  • Be integral part of the Hardware Design Team as a driver of new ideas as well as provider of feedback for improvement of existing products.
  • Continuous interaction with other departments (Software, Mechanical, etc) as part of daily board design practices and to support & maintain inter-departmental communications.
  • Support board layout as well as board and system level bring-up, debug and verification.
  • Involvement in customer support activities by site visits/giving demos /training /installation/solving customer’s field issues is essential

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Lead Mechanical Engineer `{` JOB ID : 155005`}` | Actively Hiring |” tab_id=”1610692311623-1c262c48-f1b7″][vc_column_text]Tonbo Imaging seeks a Senior Mechanical Engineer with end-to-end experience in Mechanical Design from concept, prototyping through transfer to production. The ideal person will have experience in

  • Designing & realizing motion systems, robotic subsystems which involve mechatronic components mounted on shafts and bearings with complex geometries and degrees of freedom with tight tolerances.
  • Designing & realizing alignment mechanisms and mounts for multiple imaging sensors and optronic elements
  • Designing & realizing enclosures with hermetic sealing / high ingress protection ratings for extreme environmental conditions
  • realizing designs using a spectrum of manufacturing processes and materials that include machining, casting, metal injection molding, sheet metal etc. in addition to familiarity with design for plastics.

Experience in close interactions with vendors for manufacturability discussions is necessary to perform effectively in this role.

The position involves a significant level of autonomy and responsibility in which a self-motivated applicant must work independently and closely with other subject matter specialists to develop holistic product design solutions

 

Education, Skills & Characteristics

  • Applicant should possess a Bachelors or Masters in ME from a top ranked (Tier-1 & Tier-2) institute in India.
  • Applicant must have at least 3+ years of proven experience in developing relevant mechanical designs and successfully realizing as well as validating them.
  • Strong expertise in a CAD tools preferably SolidWorks
  • Strong expertise in any analysis tools for design confirmation through simulation for structural strength and thermal performance.
  • Experience in Mechatronic component selection and sizing to meet product function is greatly desired.
  • Hands-on experience to physically assess realized design to identify source of issues arising from realized dimensional tolerances, static and dynamic balance in moving parts etc is also greatly desired.
  • Good team player and should have strong analytical, communication, logical and inter-personal skills.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment where multi-tasking will be required.

Job Responsibilities include but not restricted to

  • End-to-End Ownership from concept to realization of assemblies for prototypes and pilot builds
  • Assess, isolate and fix source of issues arising from design deficiencies, manufacturing limitations
  • Own the transfer to production, including creation of assembly jigs to aid repeatable and error free assembly during production.
  • Mentor junior engineers

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Lead Robotics Firmware & Control Engineer `{` JOB ID : 155006`}` | Actively Hiring |” tab_id=”1607058406169-16688ae2-d761″][vc_column_text]Tonbo Imaging seeks a Robotics Firmware and control Engineer with comprehensive experience in Firmware development, specifically

  • Architecting and realizing firmware for motion control systems, robotic subsystems which involve interfacing micro-controllers and GPU processors with mechatronic components, sensors and actuators
  • Configuring 8/16/32 bit microcontrollers. Interfacing peripherals over communication protocols such as SPI, UART, CAN, I2C as needed.
  • Familiarity with concepts of feedback control and signal processing to implement control and signal processing approaches in C code necessary to accomplish overall product performance
  • Hands on experience in microcontroller firmware coding and debugging along with relevant IDE tools

Experience with specific mechatronic applications in motion control, stabilization, robotics and/or flight applications with GPS, inertial sensors, vision based sensing etc will be a big advantage.

The position involves a significant level of autonomy and responsibility in which a self-motivated applicant must work independently and closely with other subject matter specialists to develop holistic product design solutions

Education, Skills & Characteristics

  • Applicant should possess a Bachelors or Masters in Electronics/ Software / mechatronics.
  • Applicant must have at least 1+ years of proven experience in developing relevant coding applications – successfully realizing as well as validating them.
  • Strong coding expertise in C, C++, python as required. Knowledge of RTOS is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with software development lifecycle as relevant to firmware including good coding practices for future maintainability.
  • Experience in Mechatronic component selection and sizing to meet product function is greatly desired.
  • Strong debugging skills. Hands-on experience to assess source of performance issues arising from system dynamics, electronics hardware vs firmware bugs and timing is greatly desired.
  • Experience with model-based simulation and development tools such as Simulink and Matlab is a big plus.

Good team player and should have strong analytical, communication, logical and inter-personal skills.

Ability to work in a challenging environment where multi-tasking will be required.

Job Responsibilities include but not restricted to

  • End-to-End Ownership from concept to realization of product functions.
  • Assess, isolate and fix source of issues arising from multiple interactions of mechanical, electronics, sensors and actuators.
  • Mentor junior engineers

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”QA Engineer `{` JOB ID : 155007`}` | Actively Hiring |” tab_id=”1607058549929-5ad35dec-22bc”][vc_column_text]We are looking for an experienced and talented quality engineer to help us in significantly scale our products for a large consumer base. You should have a solid in-depth knowledge of Quality Assurance principles, scripting languages and system testing. You will also be responsible for understanding and evolving product requirements.

Roles and Responsibilities:
1. Define test strategy and test plans for our large portfolio of products.
2. Automate testing of products and codebases.
3. Manually test and evaluate our products which cannot be automated.
4. Understand and enhance our product requirements.

7. Should also be able to put effort in integration of modules and testing.
8. Follow up on bugs with developers and ensure bugs are fixed before delivery

3. Knowledgeable in at least one programming or scripting language
4. Experience in extensive integration testing

6. Manual testing of products
7. General familiarity with common software development and integration practices
8. Outstanding communication, presentation, reporting and interpersonal skills[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Vision & Deep Learning Engineer `{` JOB ID : 155008`}` | Actively Hiring |” tab_id=”1607058591542-bad7c0b2-8fca”][vc_column_text]Tonbo Imaging is seeking a passionate and self-motivated software engineer, following job description.

We are looking for an exceptional vision and deep-learning engineer with a proven track record in a computer vision and deep-learning (e.g. multiple view geometry, stereo imaging, object detection/tracking ). As an engineer, you will be solving challenges that are at the confluence of real-time vision.

Responsibilities
The ideal candidate should be comfortable making significant contributions in a few of the following categories:
* Developing creative computer vision and imaging software
* Developing novel real-time 3D scene reconstruction techniques and delivering accurate visual odometry systems.
* Applying machine learning to computer vision problems.
* Researching and prototyping techniques and algorithms for object detection and recognition.
* Developing robust software for integrating multiple sensors and tracking systems.
* Prototyping hardware and software solutions for tracking, detection and modeling.

Requirements:
* BE/MS or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or related technical field preferred.
* 3+ years developing and designing Computer Vision technologies and systems
* 3+ years of experience engineering in C++
* Strong experince in implenting algorithms on CUDA
* Strong background in Computer Vision and Deep Learning
* Fast prototyping skills.
* Practical knowledge of machine learning, CNN, Bayesian filtering, information theory, and 3D geometry[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Electro Optics Systems Engineer `{` JOB ID : 155009`}` | Actively Hiring |” tab_id=”1607058697510-b7825145-86ef”][vc_column_text]Tonbo imaging is seeking a systems engineer with hands on experience in evaluating advanced Electro Optical Systems.   4. Extensive design, debug and troubleshooting skills for debugging imaging systems.
  5. Execute test operations such that all tests are completed in accordance with the defined test procedures and standard processes
  6. Experience in using oscilloscopes, logic/spectrum analyzers and other test equipment.

Qualifications
